card.name: Words inside quoted classic poetry
card.fires_on: Ordinary words (and, like, which, have, all) inside lines of quoted Victorian-style verse, especially Hopkins's 'God's Grandeur'. It fires within the poem lines, not on the prose around them.

modes.label: Linking words in Hopkins lines
modes.description: Small words such as and, like, have, all in the middle of lines from 'God's Grandeur'.
modes.example: It gathers to a greatness,<< like>> the ooze of oil.

modes.label: Other quoted verse
modes.description: Words inside other quoted hymn or elegy lines, such as which or are.
modes.example: For the Beauty of the earth, for the glory of the skies, for the love<< which>> from our birth, over and around us

card.plain: It lights up on everyday words inside lines of quoted old poetry, not on the surrounding commentary.
